text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing,
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi stopped and gazed up at the sky.
choice_data_list: What's the matter?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no!
I just happened to spot the observation tower I climb so often.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You can still enjoy that place even in the rain!
There's a roof over the stairs going up.
choice_data_list: The stairs... Wait, we're taking the stairs?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup! The view from there is truly exceptional.
...If you're interested, care to check it out?
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll go check it out.

text_block_list.text:
If you praise it that highly, you've got me curious.
It sounds like a great chance to get to know her better, too.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Don't take the elevator, it's that way!

Looking up at the observation tower again,
I'm reminded of just how tall it really is.

text_block_list.name: Man in a Couple
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~~
Are you planning to walk all the way up to the observation deck?

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Couple
text_block_list.text:
Yikes. Looks rough~.
You sure got guts.
choice_data_list: I've really got to psych myself up for this...!

text_block_list.text:
Stepping firmly up the stairs, one by one.
Just as my thighs began to ache slightly—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah... A firefly!
choice_data_list: What!? In a place like this...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! That's just what I call them! Those red lights flashing on top of the buildings!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
While all the other city lights stayed lit,
that one was flickering on and off...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The way it asserts 'I am right here,'
kind of makes me feel a sense of sympathy with it.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: So hang in there, city firefly!
choice_data_list: You've got a way with words, huh.
You've got a way with words, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Alright, break time's over!
Let's keep climbing higher and higher!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The observation deck is... still a ways up.
Are you doing alright, Trainer?
choice_data_list: This is more exhausting than I expected...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Trainer, attention!
And now... stretch~!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes... One, two, three, four!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Let's take it one step at a time at your own pace.
Come on, just one more push!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Oh! The riverbank we always see looks so small now.
We're really getting up there in the sky!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"That river is supposed to be super wide
when you look at it up close, but..."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It's kind of strange how completely different
it looks from here...
choice_data_list: It's a place I go to a lot, so that makes it hit even harder, huh?
It's a place I go to a lot, so that makes it hit even harder, you know?

text_block_list.text:
Enjoying the climb up the stairs, higher and higher.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*...
We've finally... made it to... the observation deck!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Now then, after you.
Once you reach the window, a sea of lights awaits beyond.

As I stepped forward, countless swaying lights spread out before me.
This scenery is without a doubt—
choice_data_list: It's exceptional.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...I've seen so much up until now.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume who shoots up to great heights at incredible speed, just like an elevator.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I always...
end up having to take the long way around...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
“Still... that's why!
There's something I know.”

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
There's scenery you can only see because of the detours.
...Because you give it your all, it becomes a special view.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: That's why I just love this scenery!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's so beautiful.
Yeah, it's really beautiful.
You can reach even greater heights.
You can go even higher!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: That's why I just love this scenery!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's so beautiful.
Yeah, it's really beautiful.
You can reach even greater heights.
You can go even higher!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Really!?
Yay! Ehe, ehehehehe.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I'm really glad I could come here together with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Because... I was able to find
a new kind of special.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Even... higher?
The elevator ends at the observation floor, but the stairs continue further up.
choice_data_list: Having taken the long way around, you already know how to climb back up.
Having taken the long way around, you already know how to climb back up.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
That means I can aim even higher,
...right?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'd love to go see the Eiffel Tower!
And the Arc de Triomphe too!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Dream big! As far as we can go!
Please come with me!
